title: Cardano’s Next-Gen Infrastructure: Andamio v2 & AI Agentic Workflows
description:
In this edition of Cardano Developers Office Hours, we are joined by Nelson Kshetrimayum and James Dunseith from Andamio to explore the evolution of their platform.

Andamio is an open-source protocol on Cardano designed for managing immutable credentials, project-based learning, and treasury governance. This session focuses on the major transition to Andamio v2, which introduces a more flexible and generalized system for on-chain credentials. We also dive into Agentic Workflows, discussing how AI agents can interact with the protocol to automate task management and contributor flows.

What we cover:

Andamio v2 Architecture: Moving beyond standard course and project systems.

Agentic Workflows: How AI and automation are being integrated into the protocol.

Live Demo: A look at the new features and developer tools available in the v2 ecosystem.

Community Q&A: The founders answer technical questions about building on Andamio.

Learn how Andamio is providing the infrastructure for decentralized organizations to scale their contribution and reputation systems.
